description: This file defines a Debug formatter class used for debugging output within the SCSSPHP project. The class extends a base Formatter class and provides methods to output detailed information about output blocks, including their lines, selectors, children, and structure. It is marked as deprecated and intended for internal debugging purposes.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A deprecated internal formatter class for debugging SCSS output, providing detailed structured output of output blocks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Debug formatter, sets default properties, and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns indentation string based on current indent level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the lines of a given output block for debugging purposes.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors of a given output block.

methods.name: blockChildren
methods.description: Outputs the children of a given output block.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about an output block, including type, depth, selectors, lines, and children.
